purpose: Teach: 宝塚/グローブ/ジャンク/アリア/運勢/グレイ/悪人/グレン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で宝塚観に行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you went to see Takarazuka with your family, didn't you.
lines.style: Teasing pounce on his name, smirk fully audible, daring him to deny it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、野球部で新しいグローブ買ったろ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, well you bought a new glove for baseball club, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting comeback, mumbled start then sharpening, chin-up challenge on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、コンビニのジャンクフード食べ過ぎだろ
lines.en: Riku, you eat way too much convenience-store junk food, seriously.
lines.style: Mock scolding, drawn-out exasperation, a grin leaking through the judgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽部でアリアの練習してたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were in music club practicing an aria, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Counterattack delivered flat and cool, quietly betting the accusation lands.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、朝の運勢チェック欠かさないな
lines.en: Riku, you never skip your morning horoscope check, do you.
lines.style: Sly sing-song discovery, leaning on the embarrassing detail with obvious relish.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、グレイのスニーカー履いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were wearing those gray sneakers again, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Cool observational jab, half-mumbled, a slight rising smirk at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画で悪人キャラ好きだったろ
lines.en: Riku, you always liked the villain characters in manga, admit it.
lines.style: Accusatory delight, pace quickening, a laugh threatening to break through.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽でグレン・グールドのピアノ聴いてたな、桜
lines.en: And you were listening to Glenn Gould playing piano, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Final trump card played slow and deliberate, quiet triumph trailing off.
